firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: Headline 'San Antonio electrical work, written into your panel schedule' is specific and benefit-driven. Phone number is prominent in the header and hero CTA area. The 'breaker switch' visual metaphor is immediately visible. 390-first.jpg: Headline wraps cleanly, CTAs are above the fold.

distinctiveness.notes: 1440-full.jpg: The 'Panel Schedule' concept is executed through the breaker switch UI in the hero and footer, and the industrial palette (Charcoal/Cream/Amber) avoids generic electrician tropes. The mono-spaced font for labels reinforces the technical theme.

type.notes: 1440-full.jpg: Oswald/Karla/DM Mono pairing is strong. Hierarchy is clear with large display headings and readable body text. Mono font used effectively for technical labels and numbers.

layout.notes: 1440-full.jpg: Good rhythm of tones (Dark -> Light -> Dark -> Light). Section shapes vary: hero split, 'Open now' band, checklist section, split content, review grid, centered ZIP tool, data table, form. No two adjacent sections feel identical.

photo.notes: 1440-full.jpg: Placeholder images are used (grey boxes). While not penalized heavily per instructions, they prevent a higher score. The layout reserves appropriate space for them.

copy.notes: 1440-full.jpg: Copy is excellent. Headlines answer homeowner questions ('Breaker keeps tripping?', 'Do you serve my neighborhood?'). 'Sample' labeling is rigorous on reviews, pricing, and license. Voice is professional and specific.

mobile.notes: 390-full.jpg: Clean vertical stack. Hero text is readable. Sticky mobile bar at bottom ('Call ... Price it') is present and functional. No horizontal scroll detected.

a11y.notes: dist/index.html: Semantic HTML structure, skip link present, focus states defined in CSS (3px outline), aria-labels on inputs, JSON-LD structured data present. Contrast appears high (cream on charcoal).

motion.notes: dist/index.html: Code structure supports motion (GSAP/Lenis, data-reveal attributes). The concept implies a 'flip' animation for the breaker switches which would be a strong wow moment. Static composition supports this interaction.

wow.notes: 1440-first.jpg: The 'Panel Schedule' filling itself in is a unique and relevant wow moment for an electrician. The breaker switch UI in the hero signals this interaction immediately.

polish.notes: dist/index.html: Favicon, OG tags, theme-color, print stylesheet, and forced-colors support are all present in the head. Footer includes proper credits and disclaimer.
